deploy.description: Goodreads 'read' shelf RSS (new item) -> create a 'Book Review' idea in the Notion Social Content data source (a finished book becomes a LinkedIn content idea). Migrated from the classic two-step Zap 'Log Book Reviews in Notion'.

trigger.trigger_note: RSS by Zapier 'New Item in Feed' — a polling (read) trigger, no auth. `url` is Dennis's Goodreads read-shelf RSS feed; `trigger_style: smart` is the classic Zap's setting. The feed guid dedups new items at the trigger, so the workflow needs no dedup ledger.
